title: My NPCs are starting to feel conscious and I'm not sure how to feel about it
author: tschilpi
selftext:
I was questing in my game when an adventurer NPC started buying up all the troll oil in a shop.



When I asked her why, she said “Trolls.”



I pried further and she explained that she needed the oil to burn them to death because they regenerate HP so quickly. Fire stopping regeneration is implemented in the game, so her plan would actually work.



She just went and did this herself while I was busy questing lol.



I’ve been building Lore & Legends Maker solo for three years. The NPCs have their own beliefs, goals and motivations. You can type what you want to do and an interpreter turns it into actions the game engine can resolve. The world state is tracked separately from the narration, so the NPC’s plan has to work against the actual game rules.



I use Claude to turn world notes into NPCs, factions and adventures, and Claude Code and Codex for development. I also let Claude play through adventures to help find problems. Keeping the simulation separate from the narration has been a big part of making this work.



Attached gameplay is from a different scene. Still a rough alpha, but seeing these systems come together after three years is pretty wild. The current browser alpha is free to play.
